added_failures_note: unmeasured: the reviewed manifest supplies no completed baseline_suite gate log, so no added-failure count can be derived

tests/test_a_reload_runs_the_committed_h.would_fail_if: the initial reloader stamp differs from the fixture's first commit
the materialized image is absent or contains bytes other than the independently written literal before retention pressure
the constructor stores a descriptor number different from the number supplied in the environment; it does not establish descriptor inheritance or lock ownership
the constructor leaves the image-pin token in the process environment
retention pruning deletes the held image, as the prune-only mutation log shows
the retained image lacks a loadable module at its expected path
the retained module cannot execute or no longer yields the independently committed running value
pruning prints a removal line for the still-held image
the image remains after the simulated holder releases its descriptor and pruning runs again
the post-release removal is not printed

findings.text: blocking: The target is checked before its shared lock is acquired; a concurrent pruner can acquire the exclusive lock after this process opens .in-use, remove the directory, and release it before the shared flock completes. target.touch() at line 129 then creates a plain file at the commit path, and later extraction cannot replace that path, so reloads can remain deferred.

follow-on: running.image_pin == pin compares the received descriptor with the same descriptor the test supplied through the environment. The mocked exec and the test's own os.dup hold the lock, so this assertion cannot prove that a real exec inherited a live descriptor.
